Aer.reason: Aer refers to a command/option in the EvalLever toolkit (e.g., evallever aer), not a human language.

Chinese.reason: Chinese refers to the Chinese language used in prompts, gold standards (e.g., Chinese GSD, Chinese HacRED), and experimental settings.

English.reason: English refers to the English language used in prompts, gold versions (e.g., English EWT), and experimental settings.
